endorsement: Official-source access does not imply NASA or ESA endorsement of ARES-NAV.

layers.name: Elevation / Topography
layers.resolution: Global 200 m DEM product; rendered MOLA hillshade is 463 m/px.
layers.availability: Hillshade display available; numerical DEM and contours are not loaded.
layers.decisionLimit: Regional relief context. Route gradient and energy require numerical heights, datum and sampling checks.

layers.name: Slope & Traversability
layers.origin: DEM-derived slope; regional CTX slope products in NASA Trek
layers.resolution: Coverage and pixel size vary by DEM; inspect each product.
layers.availability: Official regional products linked; A* currently uses synthetic local terrain.
layers.decisionLimit: Slope is only one mobility factor. Safe/challenging/unsuitable classes need vehicle-specific thresholds and obstacles.

layers.name: Surface Temperature
layers.origin: NASA Mars Odyssey THEMIS thermal infrared observations
layers.resolution: Observation-specific acquisition time, calibration and spatial resolution.
layers.availability: Official mission source linked; calibrated temperature raster not loaded.
layers.decisionLimit: IR brightness and thermal inertia are different quantities. Suit exposure also needs radiation balance, atmosphere and suit model.

layers.name: Mineral Composition
layers.origin: NASA MRO CRISM / ESA Mars Express OMEGA
layers.availability: Official CRISM instrument source linked; spectral abundance map not loaded.
layers.decisionLimit: Spectral evidence supports geological targets; hydrated minerals do not establish accessible water or ore grade. OMEGA is ESA data, not NASA-authored.

layers.name: Subsurface Water Ice
layers.origin: NASA mission observations / NASA-funded SWIM interpretation
layers.resolution: Published regional ice-consistency maps; depth and evidence vary.
layers.availability: Official published map linked; georeferenced ice raster not loaded.
layers.decisionLimit: Compare evidence for potential ice resources. Neutron hydrogen may include hydrated material; this cannot locate a local water pocket or guarantee extractability.

layers.name: Dust & Atmospheric Opacity
layers.origin: NASA MRO MARCI daily global weather-map archive
layers.resolution: Historical dated swaths; opacity retrievals require a specific calibrated product.
layers.availability: USGS/PDS archive linked; atmospheric opacity raster not loaded.
layers.decisionLimit: Cloud/dust appearance is not numerical tau. Date and local time matter for visibility and solar-power estimates; historical maps are not forecasts.

layers.name: Mission Traverse & Waypoints
layers.origin: NASA Curiosity / Perseverance mission location maps
layers.resolution: Published mission-map epoch; study anchors in ARES-NAV are approximate.
layers.availability: Official mission maps linked; user pins and synthetic EVA routes available.
layers.decisionLimit: Use actual mission maps for published rover tracks; proposed astronaut paths stay explicitly simulated. No live rover feed is claimed.

layers.name: Boulder & Obstacle Hazard
layers.origin: NASA MRO HiRISE imagery; separate synthetic route demonstration
layers.resolution: Targeted images; native pixel size and lighting vary per observation.
layers.availability: Official HiRISE source linked; validated boulder detections not loaded.
layers.decisionLimit: Inspect resolved objects and shadows in specific images. Automated detection needs scale, confidence and validation; synthetic rerouting demonstrates software only.
